productContexts.label: 10 µL film on PIGE
notes: No unique synthesis-batch ID supplied. Study-wide aggregate range is separately recorded without assigning numerical endpoints to this volume.
Selected for later sensing tests; strongest ECL intensities at this loading (PDF pp.3-4).

The 3.0 mm PIGE substrate, smoothing/rinsing, and slow 4 °C ambient-pressure drying to an optically clear film are inherited from the general film method on PDF p.2. Only deposited volume and linked figure outcomes are variant-specific; no independently quantified run or optical-clarity measurement is asserted for each volume.
PDF p.5 reports a separate three-month dark-storage test of the electrode; it is not the fabrication drying duration, and no storage temperature is specified in that paragraph.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
